text:
Predicates:
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
ApplyFor(x, y, z) ::: x needs to apply for y if x wants to work in z.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Work(x, y) ::: x works in y.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ International(x) ∧ InUS(x) → (F1(x) ∨ J1(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ International(x) ∧ InUS(x) ∧ F1(x) → ApplyFor(x, CPT, US)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
Student(mike) ∧ International(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
ApplyFor(mike, CPT, US) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
J1(mike) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
